description: Starts the ChangeNOW swap for a tfuel_swap_quote; the payout is always your signed-in Theta address. Returns status_id, pay_in_address (+ extra_id), the exact amount and the deadline; poll tfuel_swap_status. Needs sign-in (auth_challenge then auth_verify). 10 orders per hour.

refund_address.description: Your own address on the pay-in coin's chain; ChangeNOW refunds go only there

name: tfuel_swap
title: Start a TFUEL swap
